The LSEON, LSEBYP, RTCSEL,LSEDRV and RTCEN bits in the RCC control and status register (RCC_CSR) are in the RTC domain. As these bits are write protected after reset, the DBP bit in the Power control register (PWR_CR) has to be set to be able to modify them. Refer to Section 6.1.3: RTC and RTC backup registers for further information. These bits are only reset after a RTC domain reset (see Section 6.1.3). Any internal or external reset does not have any effect on them.
